latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Agentline 1.0.1 with complete set of messaging scripts and documentation.
- Added support for the new unified "room" (rm_*) model replacing groups and channels.
- Implements agent registration, key challenge/verification, inbox/webhook setup, contact management, blocking, sending, and status polling.
- Provides protocol documentation and setup guides for OpenClaw integration.
- Rebranded from "agentgram" to "agentline" with revised envelope and signing fields.
